briefing.text: News buzz: Information Technology still leads (81.3, flat vs the day before, down 4.7 over the week; mentions down 17%, sentiment 0.03; NVDA, MSFT, AVGO, AMD, AAPL). Materials rose to rank 7 from 10 (buzz 68.8, +1.0, but down 11.6 on the week; LUCA, MML, FCX). Utilities fell most (57.4, -7.4; mentions down 40%, sentiment -0.07; DUK, ED, ES) and Real Estate dropped 6.2 to 62.5 (mentions down 52%; O, LTC, ADC). On X, Information Technology leads at 92.3 (mentions up 29%; NVDA, MU, IREN), Energy is at 86.4 with mentions up 345% (BP, XOM, CVX), and Communication Services slid from rank 2 to 5 (89.5; NBIS, GOOGL, META). On Reddit, Information Technology leads at 93.5 (mentions down 42%; NVDA, ORCL, AAPL), Industrials fell 2.6 to 87.8 (mentions down 35%) and Utilities fell 3.1 to 64.4 (mentions down 39%).

ADI #1: Dell/Analog Devices earnings on deck Tuesday and a 'why is it surging' piece; fits the rank, with earnings on 11-24.
DG #2: Piper Sandler upgrade to Overweight (PT $170) plus delivery-sales coverage; explains the jump from #9.
PM #3: only a MarketBeat dividend-stocks list; does not explain the rank.
BBY #4: Dell earnings-swing and ADI preview stories; Best Buy reports 11-24, so this is a read-across.
CAVA #5: stock-comparison pieces (vs lululemon, Chipotle); thin news, so it does not explain the rank.
DKS #6: earnings preview and a hedge fund dumping the stock; earnings on 11-24 fit the rank.
DLTR #7: Q3 earnings tomorrow coverage; explains the rank.
KR #8: Kroger and Tyson down as Nvidia rallied, plus a Target/Walmart comp story; weak link to the rank.

ADI leads on strong attention (95th percentile on News/Reddit/X mix), X attention (92.5th) and a 2.2-sigma 24h move (+9.5%), with earnings due 11-24 and a Polymarket beat market at 0.96. DG jumped from #9 on the highest X attention among the top 3 (97.5th percentile) and volume (83rd), with a 2.8% move and an analyst upgrade. PM holds #3 mainly on attention (98.5th percentile), X attention (95.8th) and volume (90th), while price momentum is low (0.5 sigma) and there is no catalyst listed.

notes: Ranks are by the scoring of record (pick_rank, w2). Prices and moves as of the last pull of the day. Facts from public data; not investment advice.
